info.title: Edit Product API
info.description: Supplemental API referenced by the official POP solution but absent from the current category catalog; availability and app permission are unverified.

items.description: Qualification information. Please note that deleting the product qualification information will result in the product being penalized for non-compliance, so please do not delete the product qualification information.

key.description: Qualification information key, the key under each category is not the same, please call the qualification information query interface: aliexpress.category.qualifications.list, query the key and type of the corresponding

value.description: Specific qualification information: image link or text

items.description: Only available for polish seller right now!!! This parameter is used to set different product main images in various countries

main_image_urls.description: Max Number: 6, use ';' to split multiple image links

store_delivery_type.description: "storePickup" indicates in-store pickup and is a required field. It can support multiple values, separated by commas. "homeDelivery" indicates home delivery. Only for Saudi Arabia seller

weight_unit.description: weight unit of item. pound or ounce,  1 represents pound and 2 represents ounce. (This field right now is only available for us seller))

items.description: If specified this field, all the previous skus will be replaced by the new skus.

sku_attribute_value.description: Customized sku attribute value by sellers, do not include these 4 symbols { # : = , }.maximum 70 characters.

sku_attribute_name.description: Deprecated, please use sku_attribute_name_id. To obtain the available sku attribute names under a specific category, please check API: aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query.

sku_attribute_name_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_name_id under specific category

sku_attribute_value_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_value_id under specific category

items.description: sku attribute list. Some categories don't have sku attributes, then sku_attributes_list should be empty.When there are more than one sku in the sku_info_list, sku_attributes_list is required for each of them, please do not let them empty

Image that will represent the variation of the product. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following api: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk

sku_attribute_name.description: Deprecated, please use sku_attribute_name_id. To obtain the available sku attribute names under a specific category, please check API: aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query

sku_attribute_value.description: Customized sku attribute value by sellers, do not include these 4 symbols { # : = , }.maximum 70 characters.

sku_image.description: Image that will represent the variation of the product. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following page: https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2

sku_attribute_value_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_value_id under specific category

sku_attribute_name_id.description: Please refer to https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=29988&docType=2 to obtain the sku_attribute_name_id under specific category

sku_code.description: Code for merchant's sku, important reference to maintain the relationship between merchant and Aliexpress's system.

discount_price.description: discount price for the sku. discount_price should be cheaper than price.

extra_params.description: extra params. Configured some special products

ean_code.description: EAN or EAN13, stands for international product number (formerly European product number). It is an extension of UPC codes, and you will find them as barcodes on most everyday products. It will be empty if you don't fill it in

items.description: There are 4 types of how to fill in the content of each element in this attribute list. 1). When filling in the standard dropdown/multi-dropdown attributes, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "aliexpress_attribute_value_id"(For multi-dropdown, splitting them into multiple elements) 2). When filling in the attributes in which the value needs to be manually entered, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "attribute_value" in the element. 3). There exists a special kind of "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" of which the value represents for "Other". When encoutering this scenario, please fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id", "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" and "attribute_value". 4). Besides the three types mentioned above, if the seller would like to fully customized all the atttributes, fill in "attribute name" and "attribute_value" in the element.

aliexpress_attribute_value_id.description: aliexpress attribute value id, which could be obtained from aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query

aliexpress_attribute_name_id.description: aliexpress attribute name id, which could be obtained from aliexpress.solution.sku.attribute.query

freight_template_id.description: freight template ID. After the merchant has created an freight template in the backend: freighttemplate.aliexpress.com, the id could be obtained in the backend directly or thourgh the API: aliexpress.freight.redefining.listfreighttemplate

weight.description: Weight of the product, including package. Measured in Kilograms (Kg) with a maximum 500 and minumum 0.001

inventory_deduction_strategy.description: indicate when the inventory of a specific product will be deducted. place_order_withhold: the inventory is deducted just after the order is placed by customer. payment_success_deduct: the stock is deducted after the payment is done successfully by the customer.

shipping_lead_time.description: refer to the preparation period of merchant before the package could be dispatched to the customer.

items.description: Main image that represents the product. The url should be accesible and there is a maximum of 6 pictures. The url can point to a seller's server or to AliExpress photobank. In order to obtain more information about the photobank and how to upload images, please visit the following page: https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2

package_height.description: Package height measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1cm

package_length.description: Package length, measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1cm

package_width.description: Package width measured in centimeters (cm). Maximum 700 cm, minumum: 1cm

service_policy_id.description: service policy id, which could be set and obtained in the seller's background.

size_chart_id.description: merchant's size chart id, more used in the category of shoes and clothes.

aliexpress_category_id.description: Aliexpress leaf category ID obtained through https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=46042&docType=2

items.description: List for multi language subject. To learn how to set this field, please refer to the document:https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=108976&docType=1

language.description: Support: en(English) ru(Russian) es(Spanish) fr(French) it(Italian) tr(Turkish) pt(Portuguese) de(German) nl(Dutch) in(Indonesian) ar(Arabic) ja(Japanese) ko(Korean) th(Thai) vi(Vietnamese) iw(Hebrew).Must contains the original locale.

items.description: List for multi language description. To learn how to set this field, please refer to the document:https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=108976&docType=1

language.description: Support: en(English) ru(Russian) es(Spanish) fr(French) it(Italian) tr(Turkish) pt(Portuguese) de(German) nl(Dutch) in(Indonesian) ar(Arabic) ja(Japanese) ko(Korean) th(Thai) vi(Vietnamese) iw(Hebrew).Must contains the original locale.

mobile_detail.description: mobile detail for  this language, do not support "html" and "dynamic" type, for more information, please check the format here https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=109534&docType=1

web_detail.description: web detail for this language, please check the format here: https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=109534&docType=1

group_id.description: group id, you can get group list from aliexpress.product.productgroups.get

items.description: Sku price list under the same ship_to_country

price.description: Value of price configuration. If the price of a specific country is set, it must be greater than or equal to 70% of the original sku price

discount_price.description: Value of discount_price for each country, should be less than the retailPrice and greater than or equal to 10% of it.

ship_to_country.description: ISO code of the country. Currently supporting: RU, US, CA, ES, FR, UK, NL, IL, BR, CL, AU, UA, BY, JP, TH, SG, KR, ID, MY, PH, VN, IT, DE, SA, AE, PL, TR

price_type.description: Support absolute or delete. When filling in "delete", the multi_country_price_configuration will be eliminated.

extra_params.description: extra params. Configured some special products

items.description: marketing images for product. Currently supported 2 types: 1 represents 3:4 rectangle(resolution at least 750*1000) image while 2 represents 1:1 square image(Resolution at least 800*800). The image url needs to be obtained via uploading the image through Aliexpress API: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk(https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2)

image_url.description: The image url needs to be obtained via uploading the image through Aliexpress API: aliexpress.photobank.redefining.uploadimageforsdk(https://developers.aliexpress.com/en/doc.htm?docId=30186&docType=2)

image_type.description: 1 represents 3:4 rectangle(resolution at least 750*1000) image while 2 represents 1:1 square image(Resolution at least 800*800).

data.codeDesc: Due to EU GPSR (General Product Safety Regulation) compliance requirements, EU Responsible Person information must be included when listing or editing product information, and this data can be retrieved via the aliexpress.merchant.msr.list API.
data.solution: 出于欧盟 GPSR合规需求，需要在商品发布或者编辑的信息中添加欧盟责任人信息，可以从aliexpress.merchant.msr.list 这个 api 获取查询

data.codeDesc: SKU 日常促销价未低于基础价，价格大小关系校验不通过，商品编辑请求被拒绝
data.solution: 1. 检查请求中每个 SKU 的价格字段，确保日常促销价严格小于基础价（不能相等、不能更高）；若不需要设置促销价，请直接不传该字段。2. 如使用了分国家促销价，需逐个销售国家分别比对促销价与该国基础价，全部满足「促销价 < 基础价」后再重新提交。

data.name: app_key
data.desc: Unique app ID issued by AE Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

data.name: timestamp
data.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 2022-04-28 10:46:37 (TOP Protocol) or 1651113997000 (GOP Protocol), with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

data.name: sign_method
data.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

data.name: sign
data.desc: Part of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click here for details)

children.name: attribute_list
children.desc: There are 4 types of how to fill in the content of each element in this attribute list. 1). When filling in the standard dropdown/multi-dropdown attributes, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "aliexpress_attribute_value_id"(For multi-dropdown, splitting them into multiple elements) 2). When filling in the attributes in which the value needs to be manually entered, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "attribute_value" in the element. 3). There exists a special kind of "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" of which the value represents for "Other". When encoutering this scenario, please fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id", "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" and "attribute_value". 4). Besides the three types mentioned above, if the seller would like to fully customized all the atttributes, fill in "attribute name" and "attribute_value" in the element.
